audioUrl.zh-CN: 音频地址，可以是字符串、`AudioInfo` 对象，或由它们组成的数组；传入数组时显示上一首、下一首按钮。
audioUrl.en-US: Audio address: a string, an `AudioInfo` object, or an array of them. An array shows the previous and next track buttons.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

showToolbar.zh-CN: 是否显示工具栏，即音量、后退、前进、倍速与重新加载按钮。
showToolbar.en-US: Whether to show the toolbar: the volume, backward, forward, playback rate and refresh buttons.

skipDuration.zh-CN: 后退、前进按钮每次跳转的秒数。
skipDuration.en-US: Seconds skipped by each backward or forward button press.

style.en-US: Inline style of the root element.

theme.zh-CN: 播放器主题，可选 `dark` 或 `light`。
